title: fix(core, runtime): the residual-twin job refusal names the artifact's top level as a holder of its own kind (ADR-0150 D3)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg3zevMXhNEyHvqTjY4fe5MS)_

epic:#31527#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZXK1owt8RkS773Prv

## 维护者速读

1. 问题：同名定时任务既在某个包里声明、又在制品顶层（不属于任何包）出现时，系统会拒绝运行，但拒绝结果里的"候选持有者"列表少了一个或标错了。
2. 没有包带制品 id 时，列表只有一个包，看起来像"有歧义却只有一个选项"；有包带制品 id 时，那个包被当成持有者列出，可它根本没声明这个任务。
3. 修复后列表固定是"每个声明它的包 + 制品顶层"，顶层用新类别 `residual`（制品 id）标出，不再冒充某个包。
4. 拒绝范围不变：以前拒绝的照旧拒绝，以前能跑的照旧能跑。
5. 影响面小：这种拒绝目前只写进任务运行失败记录，没有对外接口会返回它。
6. 核心库的"持有者"类型多了一种取值（加宽，非破坏）；ADR-0150 的词汇修订由座位另行转交。

Fixes #32412

Clause-②: yes (widening) — `@objectstack/core` `PackageScopedHolder` gains `{ kind: 'residual'; ownerId }`; nothing that was answered is refused, nothing refused is answered.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no door answers this refusal to a client (it reaches only the job run's failure record), and `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx`'s `details.candidates` example is a door's, which never carries a residual.

## What changed

- **`@objectstack/core` (`package-scoped-resolution.ts`, +13/−3 in three hunks):** `PackageScopedHolder` gains `{ readonly kind: 'residual'; readonly ownerId: string }` — a stack's residual (ADR-0130 D4): the artifact's top level outside every package body, `ownerId` the artifact's id. `describePackageScopedHolder` names it `the top level of stack "<ownerId>" outside every package body (its residual)`. The rule never answers it, so `PackageScopedResolution`'s resolved `holder` is typed `Exclude<PackageScopedHolder, { kind: 'residual' }>` (and the internal `packageHolder` returns the `package` member) — a consumer of a resolution needs no new branch; only a refusal's `candidates` can carry it.
- **`@objectstack/runtime` (`app-artifact-handlers.ts`):** `jobNameRefusal`'s residual arm lists `[...declaring bodies, { kind: 'residual', ownerId: appId }]`. `jobDeclaringPackages` passes `ownerId: appId`. The message is unchanged (it still says whether the residual runs as the body carrying the id or as no package).
- **`@objectstack/cli` (`stored-package-references.ts`):** `ReferenceCandidate` gains `{ holder: 'residual'; ownerId }` and `candidateOf` spells it — the one consumer the widened union broke at compile time (it read `holder.packageId` after excluding `environment` and `platform`). The registry's rule never names a residual there, so the report's output does not move.
- Seat ruling: Claim 6812549503, kind ruling A on the card (precedent ADR-0130 D4, `UnclaimedTopLevel.ownerId`, `ObjectQL#recordResidualOwner`, ADR-0150 D2 / #31720).

## FROM → TO (every moved answer)

| Arrangement (a job name a body declares and the residual carries) | FROM `candidates` | TO `candidates` | Clause-② arm | Pin |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| S1: no body carries the artifact's id | `[package A]` | `[package A, residual(<artifact id>)]` | yes (widening) | `[#32412] … no body carries the artifact's id…`; `[#32355] JSON-loaded…` (flipped) |
| N1: body B, declaring no such job, carries the id | `[package A, package B]` | `[package A, residual(B)]` | yes (widening) | `[#32412] … a body that declares no such job…`; `[#32355] JSON-loaded…` (flipped) |
| B carries the id AND declares the job, beside A | `[package A, package B]` | `[package A, package B, residual(B)]` | yes (widening) | `[#32412] … one of several declaring bodies…` |
| the residual's owner IS the one declaring body | `'B'` (one holder) | `'B'` (unchanged) | — | `[#32412] controls…`; `[#32355] control…` |
| two bodies, no residual twin (#32071) | `[package A, package B]` | unchanged | — | `[#32412] controls…` |

Status, reason (`ambiguous-in-environment`), `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, `callerPackageId: null` and which runs are refused: unchanged.

## Consumers of `details.candidates[].kind` / `PackageScopedHolder` (condition ③)

Proof of no missed branch: `tsc --noEmit` over every package that imports a package-scoped symbol (core, runtime, cli, client, mcp, metadata, metadata-core, metadata-protocol, objectql, rest, plugin-approvals, plugin-email, plugin-security, plugin-sharing, plugin-webhooks, service-analytics, service-automation) — 17/17 `tsc --noEmit` exit 0 on b9722a774 (record `/mnt/project-files/epic-31527-seat2/card-32412/suites-typecheck-b9722a77.txt`). Before the fix two of them failed to compile: service-automation (`stored-reference-package-backfill.ts`, a resolved holder's `kind`; settled by the core `Exclude`) and cli (`candidateOf`; settled by its branch).

| Consumer | Reads | Handling of `residual` |
|---|---|---|
| core `packageScopedRefusalMessage` | `c.kind === 'platform'` for wording | via `describePackageScopedHolder`; never fed a residual (the job binder builds its own message) |
| runtime `action-execution.ts` (~5977) | `some(c => c.kind !== 'package')` ⇒ falls back to the refusal | falls back (registry refusals never carry it anyway) |
| runtime `domains/meta.ts`, `domains/automation.ts`, `domains/catalog-activation.ts`, `action-dispatch.ts`; rest `error-response.ts` | pass `candidates` through as `details.candidates` | pass-through; none of these doors meets the job refusal |
| objectql `activation-ledger-backfill.ts` (~93) | `c.kind === 'package' ? id : 'the environment'` | reads registry resolutions only, which never carry a residual |
| service-automation `stored-reference-package-backfill.ts` | resolved `holder.kind` + refused `describePackageScopedHolder` | resolved holder is now typed without residual (core); refused names via describe |
| service-automation `connector-package-scope.ts`, `engine.ts`, `flow-dispatch-key-package-backfill.ts` | candidates of registry resolutions | never carry a residual; compile unchanged |
| cli `stored-package-references.ts` `candidateOf` | `kind` → report candidate | new `{ holder: 'residual', ownerId }` branch (compile error before it) |
| `ui/`, `apps/`, objectui (`gh search code`) | — | no reader of `candidates[].kind` found |

## Tests

- New top-level describe `[#32412] the residual-twin job refusal names the residual as a holder of its own kind` in `app-artifact-handlers.job-pull.test.ts` (5 pins: S1, N1, owner among several declarers, a real `CronJobAdapter` run whose thrown refusal carries both, controls). The #32355 fixtures moved from inside its describe to module scope so both describes share them (no change to them).
- The `[#32355] JSON-loaded…` pin's two `candidates` assertions flipped (FROM → TO above).
- Core: `[#32412] a stack's residual as a holder` in `package-scoped-resolution.test.ts`.
- **Red on main** (89d815c5 + pins): runtime job-pull 4 failed | 44 passed; core 1 failed | 28 passed.
- **Green:** runtime job-pull 48 passed; core package-scoped-resolution 29 passed.
- **Ablation** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, the old candidates line put back): 5 failed | 43 passed (the four #32412 runtime pins + the flipped #32355 pin), restored, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Suites on b9722a774: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core test`, `…/runtime test`, `…/cli test` exit 0; typecheck core, runtime exit 0, cli exit 0 under `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=7168` (the default heap OOMs in `check:test-typecheck`'s `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, no diagnostic). After the final `origin/main` merge (768c808c8, 9 commits touching none of these files) the job-pull file 48/48 and core file 29/29 again.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack <changed paths>` on b9722a774: 73 derived; each run, exit code recorded before any pipe: 73/73 exit 0. `--ran`: 73 derived, 73 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. `pnpm lint` exit 0. Full non-docs build 119/119 before the run. Records: `/mnt/project-files/epic-31527-seat2/card-32412/gates-ran-b9722a77.txt`, `red.txt`, `ablation.log`. Dogfood battery not owed (no BREAKING, no `(narrowing)` arm).

## Shared files with seat 1's chain (merge-tree against each head, all clean on these files)

- `claude/project-thread-3giljf`: `packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts`, `packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.test.ts`, `packages/cli/src/utils/stored-package-references.ts` — merge-tree clean.
- `claude/project-thread-wqgmuu`: same three files — merge-tree clean.
- `claude/project-thread-du44hj`: `package-scoped-resolution.ts`, `package-scoped-resolution.test.ts` — merge-tree clean.
- `claude/project-thread-phk4r9`: `stored-package-references.ts` — auto-merges; that branch's own conflicts with main (`packages/rest/…`) are not in this diff.
- Their new `holder.kind` reads (`!== 'package'`, `=== 'package'`, `describePackageScopedHolder`) are non-exhaustive, so the widened union compiles under them.
- Sibling #32411 (server seat A) is draft PR #32563 (head 431705c8). `git merge-tree` against it: one textual conflict, `app-artifact-handlers.job-pull.test.ts` (both PRs hoist the same #32355 fixtures to module scope). Two semantic carries for whichever lands second: (1) #32563's new bind refusal `jobNameCollisions` builds the same residual candidates the old way (owner as a `package`, or the message alone), so it must adopt `{ kind: 'residual', ownerId: appId }` too; (2) with both twins enabled #32563 schedules neither, so this PR's real-`CronJobAdapter` pin (`on a real job service…`) moves to the bind refusal or to a disabled-twin arrangement. Whichever lands second merges main.
- `package-scoped-resolution.ts` hunk (condition ④): the type block (`PackageScopedHolder` + its docblock + one `describePackageScopedHolder` line), the resolved `holder` type, and `packageHolder`'s return type.

## Acceptance notes

- **filed #32570: ADR-0150 amendment row** (Tier H, not this PR; filed by epic seat 1 for the seat): D3 gains the `residual` holder kind — "a stack's residual (ADR-0130 D4), `{ kind: 'residual', ownerId }`, the top level of the artifact whose id is `ownerId`, outside every package body; never a `package` holder; named only as a refusal's candidate" — and the red-line read 6793085339's record line: the residual's job runs as the body that carries the artifact's id, or as no package, and a name it shares with a body's job is refused naming each declaring body and the residual.
- Not breaking: Clause-② `yes (widening)`, changeset `patch` for core, runtime and cli (`Metadata-protocol: none`). A downstream exhaustive `switch` over `PackageScopedHolder['kind']` without a default would need a `residual` case; none exists in this repo.
- #32411 (the same-name key collision) is out of scope and untouched.
